name: goyave-managed-component-lifecycle
instr:
Add an optional managed lifecycle for server-owned components, coordinated with server startup, request admission, and shutdown. Components declare stable identities and dependencies while existing request-local and hijacked-connection ownership boundaries remain intact. Applications can inspect deterministic, immutable lifecycle outcomes.

Lifecycle identities use `LifecycleKey string`; pointer-receiver `Component.LifecycleKey() LifecycleKey` supplies identity, while value-receiver `LifecycleError.Error() string` and `LifecycleError.Unwrap() error` expose classified causes. Re-registering one instance is idempotent, but distinct instances sharing a nonempty key produce `LifecycleDuplicateKey`. Dependencies impose stable topological startup and reverse shutdown; missing keys and cycles prevent callbacks and identify every affected key. Reports expose only completed transitions, preserve deterministic ordering and failures, and cannot be mutated through returned slices. Registration and lifecycle discovery respect ownership as one atomic operation: nested-router controllers become one server-owned participant without changing routes or metadata, and any panic or lifecycle conflict exposes no partial participant. Every server-owned composition of the same lifecycle identity, including global, router, and route middleware and shared authentication middleware or JWT controllers, participates once without changing request multiplicity, ordering, login, or authorization outcomes.
